description: One replay execution in detail, including the response body. Inputs: projectId, executionId. The body is full when the plan includes FullResponseBody, otherwise a 4KB preview, so check ResponseBodyTruncated before parsing. DeliveredBodySha256 is the SHA-256 hex of the body as sent on the last attempt, after transform and scrub: the receipt binds the bytes that left. A "No CLI connected" failure carries the listener steps.
